donor.normalization: number per original donor baryon; no normalization repair

inputs.electron_ledger: finite nonnegative abundance per donor baryon
inputs.optional_continuum: kappa length5 [m3/s] times prescribed finite n_e [m-3]; explicitly reservoir-driven

formula.free_final: free_initial-sum(Cc); reject negative beyond defined roundoff tolerance, return raw tiny negatives without clipping

generator.uniformization: nu=max(total), P=I+G/nu; nu=0 identity; split nu*dt<=10, sum Poisson terms to tail<=1e-14
generator.reference: exact event counts; scipy.linalg.expm optional independent check
generator.charge_ledger: signed reward outside one-particle nuclear generator

fixtures.expected: all arrays and ledgers unchanged exactly

fixtures.description: For each allowed channel, unit parent only, Li=zeros, free=2, hazard=1 for selected channel only, dt=log(2); expected parent=.5 daughter=.5, channel count=.5 and integer stoichiometry scaled by .5. Check forbidden hazards separately.
Run each q independently with unit parent, free=2, b_q=.6 c_q=.4 dt=log(2); parent=.5, Li_q increment=.3, Li_(q-1) increment=.2; free decrement=.2, bound decrement=.3.
unit Be4, free=.1, c4=1, dt=log(2); must reject since continuum count=.5 exceeds available electrons; no clipping or implicit replenishment
actual donor Be4, Li1, all continuum=0, all b except b4 arbitrary1; no transfer

fixtures.initial_assignment: conditional donor entirely in Be3; not recombination

fixtures.note: u exposure only; no adopted continuum physical rate

fixtures.description: analytic u->infinity endpoint, not numeric infinity input

fixtures.source: Khatri-Sunyaev arXiv:1009.3932v2 section2 eqs3-4 and Fig2
fixtures.initial: all donor Be placed in Be3; no ionization/recombination/continuum capture; thermal/statistical hyperfine mixture held fixed
fixtures.claim: conditional survival with literature approximate bound rate; not cosmological epoch or all-charge rates

fixtures.note: not a Be rate or energy prediction; remaining outgoing10eV replaces captured thermal10eV

validation.stoichiometry: test integer coefficients at unit population, then donor scaled
validation.energy: heat must be null NEEDS_ENERGY_PARTITION for actual donor
validation.electron_budget_tolerance: 1e-12*max(free_initial,total_continuum_count)+1e-25; check before subtraction; raw tiny negative residual retained, not clipped
validation.large_background_cancellation: Store delta_free=-Cc explicitly. Donor-relative check applies to delta/count before adding to order-one background; check final ledger against initial+delta at 5e-14*max(1,abs(initial)) absolute. Do not infer tiny donor capture by subtracting two order-one rounded floats.

required_outputs: frozen generator residuals and uniformization tail
full donor reservoirs retained with Be moved exactly once
electron budget failure and forbidden channel diagnostics
actual heat null with missing-input status
signed electron ledger delta separately from absolute initial/final ledger
physical_inputs_unresolved: bound rates outside explicitly optional Be3 approximation
consistent electronic energies and nuclear Q/branch conventions
stopping_rule: After bounded validation PASS hand off to independent authority review. On ambiguity or substantive failure preserve raw output and return; no model change or tolerance relaxation.
